description: Create a mail rule on a mail account: which folder and mails to consider, which attachments to import, and what to assign to the resulting documents.

action.description: What happens to processed mail: 1=delete, 2=move to action_parameter folder, 3=mark as read (default), 4=flag, 5=tag with action_parameter

assign_correspondent_from.description: 1=don't assign (default), 2=sender mail address, 3=sender name (falls back to address), 4=the correspondent in assign_correspondent. ⚠️ 2 and 3 CREATE a new correspondent for every distinct sender string — the usual cause of duplicate correspondents. Prefer 4, or 1 plus matching rules on existing correspondents.

consumption_scope.description: 1=attachments only (default), 2=whole mail as .eml, 3=.eml plus attachments as separate documents

filter_attachment_filename_exclude.description: Skip attachments whose whole filename matches

filter_attachment_filename_include.description: Only attachments whose whole filename matches, e.g. *.pdf

folder.description: IMAP folder (default INBOX); subfolders use the server's delimiter, e.g. INBOX.Invoices

maximum_age.description: Only mails younger than this many days (default 30)

pdf_layout.description: Mail-to-PDF layout: 0=system default, 1=text then HTML, 2=HTML then text, 3=HTML only, 4=text only

stop_processing.description: Skip later rules once this rule queued a document

name: create_mail_rule
